description: IRVE statique (organisation La Borne électrique) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Borne électrique. This dataset meets the specifications of the schema “IRVE static” available on the website schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: La Borne électrique. The portal shows the English title as "Static IRVE (organisation La Borne électrique)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Borne électrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
